== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-amar-banger-ds-coruscant-cr-v/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Banger DS Coruscant CR(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114005008/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-amar-banger-ds-coruscant-cr-v.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>9119b8ad0acaa9291f2681dd9df8923bd4d20c098c5e05b5608cba6b61349e05</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 22 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (PC Errata)]] (<nowiki>110_12</nowiki>, gameText): engine reference <nowiki>May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4 and adds 2 to power. Unless opponent has total ability > 6 piloting here, opponent's total battle destiny here = zero.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is *Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4 and adds 2 to power. Unless opponent has ability > 6 piloting here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.</nowiki>.
